senses.definition: (Scotland) A narrow arm or channel of the sea between an island and the mainland, or between two islands.

quotes.text: [T]hough remote / From the main ocean many a mile / Inflooded past cape, creek, and kyle, / The sea-loch flanked by precipice walls, / With ever-lessening murmur crawls, / Till 'neath the Pass he lies subdued / By the o'er-aweing solitude; […]
